name: Keygate
short_desc: Open source software license server with Stripe billing.
author: Tabloy
description: Self-hosted software license management: subscriptions, perpetual licenses, trials, floating licenses, machine activations, usage metering and Stripe payments. A self-hosted alternative to Keygen, Cryptlex and LicenseSpring.

form_fields.label: Admin email(s)
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated. These addresses become admins on first login, and only they can complete first-run setup.

form_fields.label: Stripe secret key
form_fields.hint: sk_live_... or sk_test_... The Stripe webhook is created automatically, so the app must be exposed on a public HTTPS domain.

form_fields.label: SMTP host
form_fields.hint: Optional. Without SMTP, login codes are printed in the container logs.

form_fields.label: Storage endpoint (S3)
form_fields.hint: Optional, for releases/downloads. Empty for AWS S3, https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com for Cloudflare R2, or your MinIO/Garage URL.

form_fields.label: Storage region
form_fields.hint: auto for Cloudflare R2, the bucket region for AWS S3.

form_fields.label: Storage bucket
form_fields.hint: Bucket, access key and secret key must all be set together (or all empty to disable releases).

form_fields.label: Storage public domain
form_fields.hint: Optional. Custom domain / CDN in front of the bucket, e.g. https://downloads.example.com

form_fields.label: Force path-style URLs
form_fields.hint: Enable for MinIO, Garage and most self-hosted S3. Leave off for R2 / AWS.

form_fields.label: Mot de passe PostgreSQL
form_fields.pattern_error: Lettres et chiffres uniquement (il est mis dans une URL)

form_fields.label: Clé de signature des licences (ed25519)
form_fields.hint: Générer avec : openssl rand -hex 32. Ne jamais la changer ensuite : toutes les licences émises deviendraient invalides.

form_fields.label: Clé de chiffrement (RELEASE_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY)
form_fields.hint: Générer avec : openssl rand -hex 32. Ne jamais la changer ensuite.
